column1: # Prose mentions of identifiers whose definitions are gone — DISPOSITIONED.
# Read by tools/renamed_names_left_in_prose.py. Rows silence a candidate it
# would otherwise ask about.
#   name <TAB> category <TAB> note
# category is one of:
#   historical   the prose is ABOUT the rename or about prior behaviour.
#                Renaming it destroys the record.
#   pinned       the document describes the code AS OF a revision.
#                Renaming it makes the document false.
# `stale` is NOT a category. A stale mention means the current thing and names
# the old one; it gets FIXED, never recorded here.
# Taxonomy owed to Fuel, who produced it independently while triaging a 296-file
# prefix drop: twelve prose mentions of names that no longer existed, twelve of
# twelve correct to leave.
# RATCHETED BOTH WAYS. A row whose name is named nowhere also fails the check —
# a suppression that has stopped suppressing is worse than no suppression,
# because it reads like coverage.
